mentions.name: Tinta
mentions.description: Tinta is a journal app for Android where all AI runs on the phone. After the models are downloaded it works fully offline, including in airplane mode. Users write or dictate journal entries, and a small LLM (LFM2.5 1.2B) asks follow-up questions to prompt deeper reflection; an embedding model finds older entries about the same topic and displays snippets of them under the new entry. The app is optimized to run the models on the CPU of budget phones while providing a good experience.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m building Tinta, a journal app for Android where all the AI runs on the phone. It works in airplane mode once the models are downloaded.
